 Talkha power plant.

items:
Check vibration transducer ( 39 V 1.2.3. ) for d.c 
resistance and not grounded, the vibration card: SVDC (ILOS, ILOR, ILOQ)

Using ohmmeter, check transducer cable shield to 
 determine that it is continuous from transducer to speedtronic panel, and 
 connected to common only at panel end and not at any other place.

Temporarily jumper pin 7 (C12B44) to pin 15 
 (D12B45) of SVDC. see that vibration trouble is indicated by the annunciator 
 and card mounted indicator light

Remove jumper ; press " reset " PB1 on SVDC and 
 check that annunciator can be cleared

Disconnect connector at vibration transducer and 
 check that vibration trouble is annunciated
Replace connector and reset by means of PB1

Repeat steps1 to 5 for vibration channels 
 2 and 3 if used jumper (C13B46) to (D13B47) for channel 2 and (C14B48) to 
 (D14B49) for channel 3

Measure vibration level ref. to trip setting value for the 3 channels, adjust
 R1 if the level out of setting.
 - Trip setting : 1 IN / SEC (2.54 CM. SEC>) 
 SVDC, Set point Adj. R1
 - Trip level voltage :0.141 VRMS (0.2 VOLTSPK)
Repeat step 1 at SVDC (ILOR) & SVDC (ILOQ)

Measure 
 vibration level ref. to trip setting for the three channels, adjust 
 the "ADJ" pot. R1 on the SVDC card full CW if the vibration level out of setting.

If the speedtronic calibrator is used, connect 
 one lead from the oscillator (C12B44) to the test pot (J7 on the calibrator) 
 connect the other end of the test pot (J10 on the calibrator) to PIN7 SVDC

Connect other end of oscillator (D12B45) to pin 
 15, SVDC (ACOM.)
 Note: If the speedtronic calibrator is not available, some means of 
 adjusting your oscillator output voltage between 0 volt and 0.177 volts RMS 
 must be provided.

Connect a 220 OHM resistor across pins 7 and 15, 
 SVDC, to simulate the coil impedance at 72 DEG.F. or connect the pickup

Connect a digital voltmeter across pins 7 
 (C12B44) and 15 (D12B45), SVDC
Connect a voltmeter to pin 48, SVDC

Set frequency to 100 HZ., press reset button "RST" 
 on the SVDC card

Adjust oscillator voltage per control SPEC. 
 setting

Observe that the panel meter indicates the trip 
 level voltage is per control SPCE setting

Adjust "ADJ" POT R1 CCW until the light just 
 comes on

Reduce oscillator voltage and press reset button, 
 then increase it slowly to the trip level voltage PER THH CONT SPEC. setting 
 the meter at pin 48, SVDC should indicate a logic change to 1 and the light on 
 the card should come

Repeat steps 10 and 11 until the card mounted 
 light cannot be reset at the trip level
Repeat steps from 1 to 12 for channel no 2, 3.
